sentences.text: Goulburn Valley Water’s report for the year ending June 2026 covers water supply and wastewater services in north-central Victoria.
The corporation reported completing a 7.5-kilometre pipeline connecting Katunga to treated water from Numurkah.
sentences.section: A message from our Board Chair and Managing Director

sentences.text: It reported meeting its 2025 target of sourcing 100 per cent renewable electricity.
sentences.section: A message from our Board Chair and Managing Director

sentences.text: The corporation reported completing all 51 strategic outcomes for 2025/26, with some ongoing deliverables continuing into 2026/27.
Goulburn Valley Water reported an operating loss after tax of $25.2 million, citing tax treatment of gifted assets, solar project write-offs, bushfire costs and depreciation.
